about: The one rule for 'a session's reply is ready to announce', shared by desktop/src/jarvis.rs (reply_ready, also used by feat/relay/follow.rs) and assets/js/chat-core.js (chatReplyReady). Each case: in_turn (the reader last saw the session working or attention), last (the reply it last handled), the event, and the reply to announce or null.

cases.name: a turn ends with a reply
idle without having seen the turn
an exited session counts as idle
working without background is never a reply
a turn ends on background work: the interim reply

info.reply: Build started, I will tell you.
